title: Fox sitting
desc: A fox sitting upright and looking up, solid black with the chest, ear and tail tip left uncut.

title: Two foxes walking
desc: Two foxes trotting one after the other in fine broken line.

title: Swan, wings open
desc: A swan with an S-curved neck and wings spread, white cut feather lines.

title: Bird with a flowering stem
desc: A blackbird diving with a long looping stem of bell flowers in its beak.

title: Snail
desc: A snail reaching out with its horns, the shell in fine engraved spirals and the body stippled.

title: Barn owl, framed
desc: A barn owl standing face-on on a rock, inside its double frame with the H·R monogram.

title: Barn owl
desc: The same owl on its own, frame and monogram removed.

title: Barn owl in flight
desc: A barn owl seen from above, wings swept wide, in fine line with dotted feathers.

title: Bear standing
desc: A bear up on its hind legs, looking up, with wood grain streaking through the fur.

title: Wild boar
desc: A wild boar trotting, its bristly coat in rows of short white cuts.

title: Swallow in flight
desc: A swallow swooping, wings wide and tail forked. Bird only.

title: Swallow in flight, with gouges
desc: The same swallow, keeping the gouge marks that fly out around it.

title: Hedgehog asleep
desc: A hedgehog curled into an oval, asleep, with fine white spines sweeping round its body.

title: Coiled snake
desc: A snake rising from a double coil, its scales in dark green over a pale belly. From a watercolour, so the ink versions print in two tones: solid scales over a light tint of the same ink.

title: Butterfly, dark with spotted hindwings
desc: A dark birdwing-like butterfly, veined forewings over pale hindwings ringed with black spots. Printed in three tones of each ink.

title: Butterfly, striped swallowtail
desc: A pale swallowtail with bold black stripes across the forewings and tailed hindwings. Printed in three tones of each ink.

title: Butterfly, pale with one tail
desc: A pale butterfly with dark wingtips, one long tail on the lower left wing. Printed in three tones of each ink.

title: Butterfly, pale with dark edges
desc: Pale wings with dark veins and heavy black borders around the hindwings. Printed in three tones of each ink.

title: Butterfly, banded
desc: Broad dark bands across pale wings, with spotted hindwings. Printed in three tones of each ink.

title: Butterfly, spotted
desc: Pale wings scattered with round black spots and a beaded black border. Lettering across the source removed. Printed in three tones of each ink.

title: Loon
desc: A loon on the water, its back a grid of small white cuts, with curved ripples beneath.
